forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO (carried from 2026-09-05). Iran made no public commitment to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations as of EOD Sep 5. FM Araghchi stated Aug 19 Iran 'rejects ceasefire and demands a complete end to the war.' Pezeshkian's Sep 1 SCO conditional MOU offer ('if US returns to MOU commitments, Iran will immediately reciprocate') is a conditional reciprocity offer referencing a lapsed framework — not a public commitment to resuming mediated negotiations per resolution criteria. Iranian strikes continued Sep 2-3. VP Vance Sep 4: 'no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping.' Resolution criteria unambiguously unmet.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO (carried from 2026-09-05). Both resolution paths exhausted as of July 17, 2026. Path 1 (Knesset roll-call vote confirming majority loss): no such vote occurred before the July 17 mandatory dissolution; cannot occur in a dissolved Knesset. Path 2 (Netanyahu announces early dissolution, election date moves earlier than Oct 27): the July 17 dissolution was mandatory and natural (first Knesset to complete full 4-year term since 1988), not 'early'; Oct 27 is the legally mandated date and cannot be moved earlier. Both YES paths are permanently exhausted. Judge ruling: RESOLVE-NO effective 2026-09-05.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Smotrich formally departs coalition
Degel HaTorah files formal dissolution motion in Knesset
indicators.expected_effect: Knesset already dissolved naturally Jul 17; this path is closed

VP Vance's September 4 'no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping' remained the operative US position through the Sep 5-6 evidence window. forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM announce confirmed additional kinetic strikes on Iranian territory, IRGC targets, or Iranian shadow-fleet vessels before EOD 2026-09-09?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. Historical pattern: IRGC maritime attacks on Sep 5 triggered CENTCOM retaliation same day (3 Iranian tankers struck); prior CENTCOM strikes on Sep 1 (IRGC targets inside Iran) triggered Iranian ballistic-missile retaliation Sep 1-2. The bilateral exchange pattern — IRGC provocations followed by CENTCOM kinetic response within 24-72h — has been consistent since Sep 1. IRGC has not stood down and no ceasefire or pause mechanism is in place. Trump's Sep 2 statement ('a much bigger attack if Iran retaliates again') establishes US willingness to escalate further. p=0.60 reflects high but not certain probability: US may allow a lull if IRGC halts overnight or Congress applies friction; but no such signal exists in the Sep 5-6 evidence window.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM official press release or named DoD/CENTCOM spokesperson confirms additional kinetic strikes on Iranian territory, IRGC targets (including naval assets or shadow-fleet tankers), or Iranian-affiliated shipping between 2026-09-06 and EOD 2026-09-09.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official public release (centcom.mil) OR Reuters/AP/AFP citing named DoD/CENTCOM spokesperson. Iranian state media alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Defensive US intercepts of Iranian missiles/drones without accompanying offensive US strikes = NO. US strikes on non-Iranian proxies (Houthi, Hezbollah) without named Iranian link = NO. An Iranian strike on US assets without US retaliation confirmed before EOD Sep 9 = NO.

indicators.name: CENTCOM press release naming Iranian or IRGC-linked target
Trump or SecDef public announcement of new strike wave
